name: Imasaka Yue
source: An old friend of [url=/c66131]Shin[/url]. She works as a nurse and sends off busy days at the hospital. Still, she makes time to visit "YuKuRu" to hang out, and to support the struggling café. Despite being bubbly and naive in ways, she can be keen and intuitive, being able to give advice to a troubled [url=/c64630]Yuzuri[/url] and [spoiler] spotting [url=/c66132]Kyouko's[/url] pregnancy. [/spoiler]
